metadata.source_name: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey (ACS)
metadata.table_name: B28002 - PRESENCE AND TYPES OF INTERNET SUBSCRIPTIONS IN HOUSEHOLD

variables.NAME: Geographic Area Name (County and State)
variables.B28002_007E: Broadband such as cable, fiber optic or DSL (Estimate)
variables.B28002_007M: Broadband such as cable, fiber optic or DSL (Margin of Error)

metadata.validation_scope: Initial Census-source data integrity audit (structural & basic data validity). Does not evaluate FCC data comparability or project acceptance.
metadata.disclaimer: Structural validity does not establish statistical comparability with FCC provider-reported availability, geographic representativeness, causality, or overall project feasibility. A successful basic audit is not an overall project acceptance.

file_exists_and_nonempty.description: File exists on disk and is nonempty.

header_matches_expected.description: Header matches exactly, in order: NAME, B28002_001E, B28002_001M, B28002_007E, B28002_007M, state, county

top_level_is_array.description: Top-level content is an array containing header plus data rows.

record_field_counts_valid.description: Every data record has exactly seven fields.

geography_name_valid.description: NAME is a nonempty string for every record.

fips_format_valid.description: state is exactly 2 digits and county is exactly 3 digits, preserving leading zeros.

geography_keys_unique.description: State+county FIPS keys are unique across all records.

numeric_fields_parse_integers.description: All four estimate/MOE fields strictly parse as integer strings matching -?[0-9]+.

numeric_values_nonnegative.description: All count estimates and margins of error must be nonnegative.

broadband_estimate_within_total.description: B28002_007E (broadband estimate) must not exceed B28002_001E (total households).

county_record_count_review.description: Verification of county-or-equivalent record count against official Census ACS publication.
county_record_count_review.notes: Observed count of 3222 data rows matches the official 3,222 county-or-equivalent areas published by the U.S. Census Bureau for the 2024 ACS 5-year estimates (https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs/geography-acs/areas-published.html). Per official Census documentation, county equivalents include geographic entities such as the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico municipios, and Connecticut planning regions. While the observed record count aligns with official publication, count agreement alone does not establish geographic boundary definitions, entity membership, or statistical comparability with FCC provider-reported availability data.
